description.en: All-in-one development view for DSH: file tree with lazy loading, file view/edit with version-guarded save, code highlighting, markdown preview, agent chat integration and an embedded terminal panel.
description.zh: DSH 一体化开发视图：懒加载文件树、文件查看与编辑（版本守卫保存）、代码高亮、Markdown 预览、agent 对话集成与内嵌终端面板。
